caption: The drawing depicts a single, rounded jar or container placed against a plain, off-white background. The jar is cylindrical in shape with a broad, slightly curved body and a narrower, flat-topped neck with an open mouth. The surface of the jar is rendered in shades of brown, tan, and muted ochre, giving it an earthenware appearance with subtle variations in color that suggest texture. The shading around the object’s curves adds a three-dimensional effect. The jar casts no visible shadow on the simple background. In the lower right corner, the letters "M.A.R.S" are handwritten in red ink next to a small red star. At the top of the page, there is faint handwritten text in pencil that includes several words or notes and numbers. No other objects or decorative elements are present in the composition.
